title: CONFIGURE Default Dev Branch, Security Automation & Formatting Utilities
content:
**What**: Configured GitHub default branch to `dev`, unified UI number/currency/date formatting helpers under `src/lib/format.ts`, and implemented enterprise security CI workflows (Semgrep SAST with SARIF upload to GitHub Security, TruffleHog secrets scanning, CycloneDX SBOM generation, and PR dependency reviews).
**Why**: Aligns repository workflow and branch strategy with the enterprise ecosystem (tumi-suite reference), enhances supply-chain visibility, prevents credential leaks, and ensures consistent Colombian Peso (`es-CO`/`COP`) formatting across POS views.
**Where**: `.github/workflows/`, `src/lib/format.ts`, `src/components/`, `src/pages/`.
**Learned**: Public repositories benefit from automated SARIF security dashboard uploads and Dependabot/Dependency reviews with zero configuration barriers, providing continuous enterprise-grade posture.
